data.title: Reranking
data.tagline: Reordering an existing set of retrieved candidates by relevance to the question.
data.description: For a refund-timing question, move the timing passage ahead of general application conditions.
data.learningOutcome: Check whether the correct passage was retrieved first. Compare candidate order before and after reranking on representative questions.

data.boundary: Reranking cannot recover a missing candidate. Its scores do not establish truth or replace access and version filters.
data.agentPrompt: Record candidate order before and after reranking. Compare relevant-passage placement on the same questions, investigate missing retrieval first, and retain source, permission and version filters.
